content.description: A detailed timeline chart tracking Hurricane Florence from Monday, September 10 to Wednesday, September 19. The chart categorizes activities horizontally into 'Events', 'Business Impacts', and 'IT Actions'. Color-coded nodes are placed along the timeline to indicate specific incidents, such as 'SOE Declared' and 'Florence landfall' in red, DMV closures in orange, GIS mapping actions in green, Web Services in blue, and Infrastructure actions in yellow.
content.caption: Legend: Red = Hurricane Florence events, Orange = DMV impacts, Green = GIS actions, Blue = Web Services actions, Yellow = Infrastructure actions

content.description: A line chart titled "Usage Time Series" displays the number of item views for the "NCDOT Weather Event Information Map" between August 26 and October 25. The chart shows a significant, dramatic spike in traffic centered around September 17–20, rising from a baseline of approximately 15 views per day to over 3,000 views, resulting in a total of 26,138 views for the period.

content.text: Most of the views were generated in that time window with over 200 times increase of daily viewing from about 15 to over 3000.
